globalAnalysis.visualFlow: Waves in the sky and fjord collide with the bridge's hard diagonal and converge on the central screaming figure.
globalAnalysis.curatorialNote: Curving nature and atmosphere should feel unstable; the bridge supplies geometric pressure while the figure carries the human climax.

cells.label: Red sky entering
cells.interpretation: Hot horizontal bands enter the painting with restless pressure.

cells.label: Sky crest
cells.interpretation: Layered warm bands bend around a cold blue streak.

cells.label: Burning sky center
cells.interpretation: The brightest sky bands stretch and pulse above the emotional center.

cells.label: Sky pulled to the edge
cells.interpretation: The sky's long waves are abruptly contained by the red edge.

cells.label: Distant walkers and railing
cells.interpretation: Small walkers recede along the hard diagonal bridge boundary.

cells.label: Fjord turning inward
cells.interpretation: The pale fjord curls from the horizon toward the central figure.

cells.label: Dark fjord wave
cells.interpretation: A deep blue-black band bends sharply behind the figure.

cells.label: Shoreline vibration
cells.interpretation: Closely repeated curves make the landscape appear to vibrate.

cells.label: Bridge thrust
cells.interpretation: Strong converging boards drive the eye toward the scream.

cells.label: Bridge meets the figure
cells.interpretation: The bridge's hard perspective compresses into the figure's body.

cells.label: The scream
cells.interpretation: The open mouth and enclosing hands form the painting's human and emotional peak.

cells.label: Echoing shoreline
cells.interpretation: The shoreline repeats the figure's wavering contour as an environmental echo.

cells.label: Empty bridge foreground
cells.interpretation: Long bare boards extend the scene toward the viewer.

cells.label: Figure's held body
cells.interpretation: The narrow dark body anchors the face while the arms rise toward it.

cells.label: Body dissolving into shadow
cells.interpretation: The figure's body lengthens downward and merges with the bridge darkness.

cells.label: Railing and red boundary
cells.interpretation: Hard diagonal rails collide with the vertical red edge.
